mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( COMMENT_NO , REF_MNO , REF_BNO , COMMENT_CONTENT , REG_DATE , STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_CNO.NEXTVAL , #{refMno} , #{refBno} , #{commentContent} , SYSDATE , DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_NO commentNo , C.COMMENT_CONTENT commentContent , M.MEMBER_ID memberId , M.MEMBER_IMAGE memberImage FROM TB_COMMENT C JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON C.REF_MNO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.REF_BNO = #{boardNo} AND C.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NO DESC
